props.gloss_en: the mishna: young girls may go out [on Shabbat] with strings
Shmuel's father did not let his daughters go out with strings
and he did not let them lie next to one another
and he made mikvaot for them in the days of Nisan
and mats in the days of Tishrei
Rav Huna: women who rub against one another are disqualified from the priesthood
[Shmuel's father] held: [he kept them apart] so that they would not grow used to a foreign body
Rav: rain in the West -- its great witness is the Euphrates
[Shmuel's father] held: lest the dripping [waters] be more than the flowing
Shmuel: the river is blessed [increases] from its own bed
Shmuel: water does not purify when flowing, except the Euphrates in the days of Tishrei alone

supports.gloss_en: לא שביק להו גניאן גבי הדדי -- לימא מסייע ליה לרב הונא: let us say his not letting them lie together supports Rav Huna

deflected_by.gloss_en: לא -- סבר כי היכי דלא לילפן גופא נוכראה: no, he held [they should be apart] so that they would not grow used to a foreign body (= p_taam_lo_yilfan_guf_nochri)

supports.gloss_en: ועביד להו מקוה ביומי ניסן -- מסייע ליה לרב: his making a mikveh for them in Nisan supports Rav; he held, lest the dripping be more than the flowing

objections.gloss_en: לא שביק להו יוצאות בחוטין -- והאנן תנן: הבנות יוצאות בחוטין! -- he did not let them go out with strings, yet we learned that girls may go out with strings
